forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 23 of June, teams completed 1 visit, with 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams active. So far, 15 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 12 areas released and 6 cleared; mines were found in 3 areas.

For the officer’s attention: the access feed shows 11 zones closed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. A new plan, P06, was approved this week.

The forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, gives a range of 10 to 14 mine areas cleared this season and 7 to 11 zones declared free.
